book.title: Career and Technical Education Grade 7 Student Textbook
book.subject: cte
book.unit_title: Introduction to Career and Technical Education (CTE)

keywords.def: The path of progress a person follows to reach their life goals.
A life goal: what you want to be in the future.

en.text: A career is the path of progress a person follows to reach their life goals. It includes the jobs a person holds, the positions they earn and the work they do over a long time. A teacher, a doctor or a hairstylist can each have a career.

screens.title: Hiwot's dream
screens.ask: Hiwot wants to become a doctor. She studies hard, then works in a clinic for many years. What is this long path called?
screens.after: A long path toward a life goal is called a career. Read on.

screens.title: Brainstorming question
screens.ask: In what type of job do you want to engage in the future? Why?
screens.answer: Any job is fine if you give a reason. Example: "A teacher, because I want to help children in my community."

screens.title: 1.1 Meaning of career
paras: A career is the path of progress people follow to realize their aspiration.
An aspiration is a life goal: what you want to be in the future.
This path runs through your education and your work life.

screens.title: A career over time
paras: For a working person, a career is made of many things.
It includes the different jobs the person has held.
It includes the titles or positions earned, and the work done over a long time.
So a career is a choice of field and advancement in that field.
screens.note: Examples: a high school director, a teacher, a doctor, a hairstylist.

screens.title: What a career includes
screens.ask: Tap each part of a career.
items: Example: helper, then assistant, then manager.
Example: teacher, then head of department, then director.
Work done over a long time
All the work you accomplish over the years.

screens.title: Key words
defs: The path of progress a person follows to reach their life goals.
A life goal: what you want to be in the future.

opts: The path of progress a person follows to reach their life goals
Any money you earn in one day
screens.ans: The path of progress a person follows to reach their life goals
screens.why: The book defines a career as the path of progress to realize one's aspiration.
screens.clue: Think of a path toward what you want to be.

screens.ask: What one wants to be in the future is one's ___.
screens.why: A life goal is an aspiration. The path toward it is a career.

screens.text: A career includes the different jobs a person has held over a long time.
screens.why: A career comprises the jobs held, titles earned and work done over a long time.

screens.text: Which of these is an example of a career?
opts: Working as a teacher for many years and becoming a school director
screens.ans: Working as a teacher for many years and becoming a school director
screens.why: It shows progress in one field over a long time.
screens.clue: Look for progress over many years.

screens.text: Chala sold shoes in Merkato for a year. Then he trained as a tailor and now runs a tailoring shop. Which is true?
opts: Chala has no career because he changed work
Chala's career includes both jobs and his progress
A career can only have one job
screens.ans: Chala's career includes both jobs and his progress
screens.why: A career includes the different jobs a person has held and the advancement made. Changing jobs can be part of a career.
screens.clue: Does a career include all the jobs a person has held?

test.text: A career is best described as:
opts: A path of progress toward life goals
test.ans: A path of progress toward life goals

test.text: An aspiration is what you want to be in the future.
test.why: An aspiration is a life goal.

test.ask: A career includes the jobs, titles and ___ a person has over a long time.
test.why: Jobs held, titles earned and work accomplished.

test.text: A career only covers what a person does today.
test.why: A career covers education and work life over a long time.

test.text: Almaz was a nurse, then a head nurse, then a hospital manager. This shows:
test.why: Moving up to higher positions in one field is career advancement.

notes.text: The Brainstorming Question is open; it is shown as a think-then-reveal block with a model answer.
